why: Settings > Server > This Mac on Your Tailnet needs one PageRoute (and its comment) in PageFactory's Settings route list, the only place Settings routes are registered. Its provider, SettingsTailnet, lives in CmuxNextAccounts; it must be Swift because acpmux answers `_acpmux/tailnet/*` only to the proven person and the proof's key lives in the app alone (acpmux hub/person.rs). No App logic is added.
